In my [post](../2026-07-30-ssa-presidency/index.qmd) on becoming President of the Statistical Society of Australia (SSA), I mentioned that I'd write a post about volunteering. Well, here it is. 

While taking a moment to appreciate how volunteering has impacted me is nice, I'm also hoping this can serve as a little propaganda to encourage people (YOU!) to volunteer. Fortunately for you though, volunteering for a professional society like the SSA is much lower stakes than enlisting in the army.
